columns.description: Period ID of source event date

columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: METRIC_TYPE
columns.description: Metric Type possible values: ORA_CN_TRX_CRD_RATIO_DIST, ORA_CN_TRX_AMT_DIST

columns.name: METRIC_BUCKET
columns.description:
Metric Bucket values depends on metric type.

For ORA_CN_TRX_CRD_RATIO_DIST possible values are: ORA_CN_RATIO_*

For ORA_CN_TRX_AMT_DIST possible values are: ORA_CN_TRX_AMT_*

columns.name: NUMBER_OF_TRANSACTIONS
